topics.label: Lecture framing and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes students to the final BOD lecture and sets out its subject and learning objectives.

topics.label: Surgery and radiotherapy in cancer treatment
topics.groupedBecause: These treatments remove or damage tumors directly, with success shaped by factors such as tumor location, spread, and early detection.

topics.label: Cytotoxic chemotherapy: mechanisms, benefits, and limitations
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cytotoxic drugs damage cancer cells and consider their clinical effectiveness, toxicity, and resistance.

topics.label: Targeted exploitation of cancer-cell vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These treatments exploit dependencies or defects in cancer cells to affect them more selectively than healthy cells.

topics.label: Oncogene-targeted therapy and resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe targeting cancer-driving oncogenes, especially kinases, and explain why treatment selectivity and resistance limit their effects.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody–drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: Both approaches use antibodies that bind cell-surface targets to direct a therapeutic effect toward cells carrying those targets.

topics.label: Immune surveillance and checkpoint inhibition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine evidence that immunity can recognize tumors and how checkpoint blockade can restore antitumor T-cell activity.

topics.label: Directing T cells toward cancer cells
topics.groupedBecause: Both approaches bring T cells into targeted contact with tumor cells to promote their destruction.

topics.label: Therapy challenges and personalized treatment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic considers why cancer treatments do not work uniformly and how biomarkers and sequencing may help match patients to therapies.

topics.label: Cancer outcome trends and prevention or early detection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic assesses changes in cancer outcomes alongside the contributions of prevention and earlier detection.

topics.label: Future cancer treatment priorities and ethical dilemmas
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic considers future treatment priorities and the ethical choices involved in balancing treatment, quality of life, and palliative care.

topics.label: Lecture closing: childhood leukaemia survival
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture with a success story about improved childhood leukaemia survival and the difficulty of testing new treatments against that record.
